text:
maria: Quick thread on export schema & provenance selection for Batch -> Preview -> Export. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/klmn4567/export-schema (screenshot attached)

maria: Problem: PM wants users to be able to choose which provenance fields ship with an export (e.g., source_url, chunk_id, highlight_snippet) but our current modal only shows a flat "include metadata" toggle. Testers aren't sure what exactly gets exported.

jamie: yep, seen confusion in the lab. Suggest adding a lightweight field picker in the modal with checkboxes and a small live CSV header preview above the CTA.

sean: +1. Also we need to handle long metadata values (notes, full_text). For CSV we should default to truncating to 200 chars and include a "full text in JSONL" option for heavy exports.

lina: Accessibility: the field picker has to be keyboard-accessible and SR-friendly. Each checkbox should have aria-describedby pointing to a short helper text like "Will be exported as CSV column 'source_url'".

aqil: Copy nit: change "Include metadata" to "Choose fields to export" and make the primary CTA explicit: "Download CSV (selected fields)". Secondary action: "Export as JSONL (full text)".

oliver: UX thought: show a one-line sample header that updates as users toggle fields, e.g.:
```
id,embedding_vector,source_url,chunk_id,highlight_snippet
```
Make it selectable so users can copy sample headers for quick scripts.

maria: Good. Also add a small protection for PII-heavy fields: if a selected field has been flagged by our data scanner, show a red warning pill: "Contains sensitive text — confirm to include" and require a second confirm (checkbox) to proceed.

lina: For the warning, announce it via aria-live polite and focus the confirm checkbox when it appears. Also include SR-only text: "Selecting this field may include personally identifiable information.".

jamie: For export formats: if user picks JSONL we should include a nested "provenance" object with full fields. For CSV we flatten and truncate. Add small microcopy: "CSV: flattened, truncated; JSONL: full fields, larger file size." with estimated size hints.

sean: Performance note: building CSV previews for 50k rows is expensive. Make preview sample only first 10 rows and show a "Previewing 10 of N rows" label to set expectations.

aqil: Telemetry: we'll need events for export_schema_changed and export_provenance_confirmed. Ping @eng-infra before shipping to lock event names.

designbot: Reminder: update the product spec if adding the PII confirm flow and check with Legal for required copy.

maria: Action items:
- Lina: a11y annotations and aria-live examples + SR copy
- Aqil: update modal copy and PII confirm copy + PR
- Jamie: implement field picker UI + Live header preview (sample 10-row behavior)
- Sean: add limits/truncation defaults and JSONL export path
- Oliver: add selectable header snippet and size estimate microcopy

maria: I'll update Figma with the new modal and drop a short spec in the ticket. Scheduling a 20m sync tomorrow 2:30pm to walk through edge cases. Thanks! :thumbsup:
